title: Vibe.ai
tagline: AI-powered platform that identifies, analyzes, and rewards authentic contributors via interaction
description: Vibe AI solves the critical problem of misaligned incentives in Web3 communities by distinguishing genuine value creators from airdrop farmers and rewarding them accordingly. Our platform deploys intelligent bots across community platforms to monitor interactions, evaluate contribution quality, and distribute rewards transparently.
how_its_made: Vibe AI's Discord and Telegram bot to continuosly capturing user conversation, review, summarize and rate it with AI, the score will then convert to reward token and NFTs on Flow, projects able to tips or reward within community automatically or manually. Beside this, it using Self and Celo to deploy onchain verification to filter bot and spam behaviour.
